title: 第21章 青纹朱果第22章 冲击失败
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第二十一章青纹朱果
紫炎虎发出一声怒吼，随后身形一动，朝着方羽扑了过来。
“呛啷。”
方羽右手也随之而动，一道银光闪耀而出，手中之剑自空中划过，同时方羽的身体一动，一个借力腾挪，身形越到几步之外。
而紫炎虎也随之发出一声痛呼。
只见其身侧，原本那干净的紫色毛发，已然被鲜血染红。
刚才方羽腾挪闪避之时，手中的剑却是在它身上划出一道血口。
紫炎虎转过身来，那双虎瞳已然血红，看着方羽眼中充满了暴戾。
方羽感受到紫炎虎眼中的杀机，周身气劲开始被调动起来。
右脚微微弯曲，随后方羽不等紫炎虎有所动作，一个借力朝着紫炎虎冲去。
紫炎虎看到方羽居然主动进攻，似乎感觉自己的威严受到了挑衅，当下周身一股紫色的力量随之涌出。
随后一个侧身，那条虎尾犹如一根长鞭，一般朝着方羽甩了过来。
方羽没想到紫炎虎居然用虎尾攻击，当下手中剑式一变，转劈为提。
那根虎尾甩在方羽手中的长剑之上，放出一声脆响，随后方羽只感觉一股巨力顺着右臂涌到胸口。
身形也不由朝着后方倒退开来。
足足倒退了十几步，倒退之时，数棵碗口粗细的树木，被方羽直接撞断。
止住身形之后，方羽只感觉胸口一阵气血翻涌。
不过随着体内造化之气流转，很快那翻涌的气血就平复了下来。
方羽看着那紫炎虎，右手骤然松开精铁剑。
双拳微微一握。
紫炎虎看着方羽，发出一声怒吼，瞬间腾空而起，朝着方羽扑来，那双利爪，散发着森然的寒芒。
方羽看着腾空的紫炎虎，右拳气劲不断凝聚。
在紫炎虎即将靠近的时候，方羽目光随之一凝，整个人散发出一往无前的气势，方羽同时右拳随之而动，一拳轰出，一股气劲透拳而出。
凭空中，一声龙吟骤然响起。
空中隐隐现出一只硕大的龙首。
那紫炎虎听到这一声龙吟，那双虎瞳轻轻一颤，虎躯也不由轻轻一震，前爪也不由微微一曲。
方羽也感受到了紫炎虎的变化，手中的动作没有任何停滞。
空中也随之传来一声声气爆。
方羽一拳直接轰在紫炎虎的一只虎爪之上，发出一声轰鸣，一股劲风随之爆发开来，方羽身上的衣袍也随之飘飞了起来。
一击之下，方羽的身形不由朝着后方倒退了几步。
而紫炎虎身形却是倒飞了出去。
最后直接砸在两丈开外的草丛中。
方羽看着远处的紫炎虎，却没有想就此放过它，双腿一个借力，瞬间腾空而起。

Chapter 21: Green Vermillion Fruit
"Roar."
The Purple Flame Tiger roared, then moved and rushed towards Fang Yu.
"Changlang."
Fang Yu's right hand also moved accordingly, a ray of silver light shone out, and the sword in his hand passed through the air. At the same time, Fang Yu's body moved, using his strength to move forward, and his body was a few steps away.
"Roar."
The Ziyan Tiger also let out a cry of pain.
I could see that the originally clean purple hair on his side was stained red with blood.
When Fang Yu moved to dodge just now, the sword in his hand made a bloody gash on its body.
Zi Yanhu turned around, his tiger eyes were already blood red, and he looked at Fang Yu with eyes full of violence.
Fang Yu felt the murderous intent in Zi Yanhu's eyes, and his energy began to be mobilized throughout his body.
His right foot bent slightly, and then Fang Yu didn't wait for the Ziyan Tiger to make a move, and used his strength to rush towards the Ziyan Tiger.
Seeing Fang Yu taking the initiative to attack, Zi Yanhu seemed to feel that his majesty had been challenged, and a purple power surged out from his body.
Then he turned sideways, and the tiger tail was like a long whip, swinging towards Fang Yu.
Fang Yu didn't expect that the Purple Flame Tiger would actually attack with its tiger tail. At that moment, the sword style in his hand changed, switching from chopping to lifting.
"Keng."
The tiger tail flicked on the long sword in Fang Yu's hand, making a crisp sound, and then Fang Yu felt a huge force rushing down his right arm to his chest.
His body couldn't help but move backwards.
"Kaka..."
He took a dozen steps back. As he was going back, several trees as thick as bowls were directly broken by Fang Yu.
After stopping his body, Fang Yu felt a surge of blood and energy in his chest.
However, as the energy of creation circulated in the body, the surging energy and blood soon calmed down.
Fang Yu looked at the purple flame tiger and suddenly let go of the fine iron sword with his right hand.
He clenched his fists slightly.
"Roar."
The Purple Flame Tiger looked at Fang Yu, let out a roar, instantly rose into the air, and rushed towards Fang Yu, its sharp claws exuding a cold light.
Fang Yu looked at the purple flame tiger flying in the air, and the energy in his right fist continued to gather.
When the Purple Flame Tiger was about to approach, Fang Yu's eyes condensed, and his whole person exuded an indomitable momentum. Fang Yu moved his right fist at the same time, punching out, and a burst of energy came out of the fist.
"Ang."
Out of the air, a dragon roar suddenly sounded.
A huge dragon head loomed in the sky.
When the purple flame tiger heard this dragon roar, its tiger eyes trembled slightly, its body couldn't help but tremble slightly, and its front paws couldn't help but flex slightly.
Fang Yu also felt the changes in Zi Yanhu, and there was no stagnation in the movements of his hands.
"Pa bang bang..."
There were also air explosions in the air.
"Bang."
Fang Yu punched directly on one of the purple flame tiger's claws, making a roar, and a strong wind burst out, causing Fang Yu's robe to fly.
With the blow, Fang Yu couldn't help but take a few steps backward.
But the Purple Flame Tiger's figure flew out upside down.
"Bang."
Finally, it hit the grass two feet away.
Fang Yu looked at the Purple Flame Tiger in the distance, but he didn't want to let it go. He used his legs to use force and instantly jumped into the air.
